newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian soccer boss wounded, bodyguards slain.
newsitem.headline: Colombian soccer boss wounded, bodyguards slain.

text.p: The director of one of Colombia's top-flight soccer clubs was wounded and three of his bodyguards killed in an early-morning shooting on Thursday, police said.

One of the bodyguards opened fire on the two others, killing them immediately, and then shot and wounded Gustavo Upegui Lopez, director of the Envigado soccer club, police said. The killer then committed suicide.
Police did not know what sparked the shooting on a farm in Colombia's northwest Antioquia province.
Last year two of Upegui's sons were kidnapped and a club player was shot dead in unexplained circumstances near the city of Medellin.
